title: Mechanism of Compound Xinyi Nasal Drops in the Treatment of Allergic Rhinitis Through STAT3/IL-17A/NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway Based on Network Pharmacology and Experimental Verification.
authors: Gu, Congwen; Tan, Jiaxin; Gen, Shuang; Cao, Gang; Hong, Yan; Han, Yanquan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方辛夷滴鼻剂通过STAT3/IL-17A/NF-kappaB通路治疗过敏性鼻炎，虽含分子对接但核心为信号通路与湿实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Compound Xinyi nasal drops (CXND) is a traditional Chinese medicine nasal drop developed from an empirical clinical prescription for the treatment of allergic rhinitis and has been used for more than 20 years, with precise therapeutic efficacy. However, the mechanism of action of CXND in treating allergic rhinitis remains unclear. Investigating the impact of CXND on allergic rhinitis and further defining its potential active ingredients and mechanism of action were the objectives of this study. The effective components of CXND were determined by ultra-performance liquid chromatography, and the core genes and important pathways of CXND in the treatment of AR were analyzed by network pharmacology. Then, molecular docking verified component-target binding activity. The guinea pig model was induced by OVA to study the effects of CXND on the STAT3/IL-17A/NF-kappaB signaling pathway and related inflammatory factors. The fingerprint spectrum of CXND was established, and seven effective components were identified. It was found that the seven components might exert their therapeutic effects on allergic rhinitis through the STAT3/IL-17A/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. In vivo experiments have found that CXND can effectively reduce the levels of IL-6, IL-17A, and TNF-alpha while inhibiting the expression levels of STAT3, IL-17A, NF-kappaB p65 mRNA, and their phosphorylated proteins.
abstract_zh: 复方辛夷滴鼻液（CXND）是一种源自临床经验方、用于治疗过敏性鼻炎的中药滴鼻液，已使用20余年，疗效确切。然而，CXND治疗过敏性鼻炎的作用机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在探讨CXND对过敏性鼻炎的影响，并进一步明确其潜在活性成分及作用机制。通过超高效液相色谱法确定CXND的有效成分，并利用网络药理学分析CXND治疗AR的核心基因及重要通路。随后，通过分子对接验证成分-靶点结合活性。以OVA诱导豚鼠模型，研究CXND对STAT3/IL-17A/NF-kappaB信号通路及相关炎症因子的影响。建立了CXND的指纹图谱，并鉴定出七种有效成分。研究发现，这七种成分可能通过STAT3/IL-17A/NF-kappaB信号通路发挥对过敏性鼻炎的治疗作用。体内实验发现，CXND能有效降低IL-6、IL-17A和TNF-alpha水平，同时抑制STAT3、IL-17A、NF-kappaB p65 mRNA及其磷酸化蛋白的表达水平。
